reviews.text: Mazzy Star (German Shepherd) has been trained so well! She loves Emily. Emily has been over to our home multiple times to help with in-home training & outdoor training. I recommend training from Canine Sports to everyone who has a dog. It’s so nice to hear - “your dog is so well behaved.” Such a good girl! I only bring my dog here for any kind of boarding, as well. They take great care of her!

I wholeheartedly recommend Canine Sports. I brought my pitbull in for two rounds of puppy class, and then continued with agility training for about five years. We also participated in pack walks, drop in classes, day care, and boarding. After an at-home incident with my dog, Emily and Natalie helped with reinforcing good dog manners.

If we didn’t live out of state now, we would still be visiting with Emily and Natalie! The consistent training and support helped my dog to be a solid listener and enabled him to run off-leash at the parks, living his best dog life!
